## [Overview](https://security.surveysparrow.com/?itemName=overview&source=click)

This Trust Center provides you with resources demonstrating SurveySparrow's continuous commitment to protecting customer data. We prioritize security as our highest-level product strategy and build our platform using best practices for highly available, scalable, and secure cloud applications. We regularly monitor and assess our program to ensure it meets or exceeds compliance and regulatory requirements.

### SurveySparrow's Response to PHP2Shell Vulnerabilities

Vulnerabilities

October 29, 2026

SurveySparrow is not affected by the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) disclosed on 21 October 2026. Our platform does not run on PHP, so there is no exposure to these flaws.

No action is required by customers.

If you think you may have discovered a vulnerability, please send us a note.

[Report issue](mailto:security@surveysparrow.com?subject=SafeBase%20Responsible%20Disclosure%20Report%20for%20SurveySparrow)
